picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope is the most concrete scientific deliverable yet from DOE's new Genesis Mission — a working demonstration that AI-guided instruments can already accelerate astrophysical discovery, not just a grant announcement.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: An $874 million federal commitment to semiconductor R&D under the CHIPS Act directly targets the compute bottleneck constraining AI development nationally — a policy and funding move with outsized downstream impact on every AI-dependent research program.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into the Genesis Mission exemplifies the unprecedented scale of DOE's push to fuse AI, supercomputing, and quantum computing across academia, industry, and government — a partnership model that could reshape how large scientific problems get funded and solved.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge joining CuspAI's global AI Materials Foundry signals growing international convergence around AI-driven materials discovery, pairing simulation with robotic experimentation to compress years of lab work into a fraction of the time.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry

picks.editorial_note: RPI's leadership on two DOE Genesis Mission projects, including an AI-guided rare-earth materials effort with Ames National Laboratory, ties directly into US critical-mineral supply chain resilience — a rare case of AI research with immediate strategic stakes.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restoring an ALS patient's own voice is a milestone in neuroprosthetics with immediate, tangible human impact — the kind of result that demonstrates AI's value beyond research metrics.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: The $21.5 million NSF AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation, spanning Delaware, Florida, Princeton, Penn, and Delaware State, represents a major federal bet on AI-clinician collaboration for rehabilitation and health care.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's five Genesis Mission awardees, selected from over 5,000 applications for just 278 inaugural slots, underscore how competitive and consequential this new DOE program has instantly become across the research landscape.
picks.title: UC Davis Researchers Selected for Landmark DOE Genesis Mission Awards

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska's $18 million NSF MRSEC award to study ultra-thin quantum materials could underpin faster, more energy-efficient computing hardware — foundational research with long-term payoff for AI infrastructure itself.
picks.title: Husker team earns elite NSF award to drive next generation of materials research

picks.editorial_note: William & Mary's Genesis Mission award to build AI foundation models for particle physics, in partnership with Jefferson Lab and Brookhaven National Laboratory, shows how AI is becoming core infrastructure for fundamental physics discovery.
picks.title: William & Mary receives DOE Genesis Mission award to advance AI-powered particle physics
